payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition of the problem of session segmentation in human-computer conversation systems, highlighting the need to retain relevant context while discarding irrelevant utterances.

claims.text: The problem of session segmentation involves retaining near, relevant context utterances and eliminating far, irrelevant ones in conversation systems.
Tracking all previous utterances in a session is unwise due to the varying importance of each utterance, necessitating session segmentation.
